pma:database.pma:table: CREATE TABLE `ghome` ( `ghid` int(11) NOT NULL, `ghfile` varchar(250) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL, `ghtext` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL, `date` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `msg` varchar(300) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE `home` ( `sid` varchar(40) NOT NULL, `tid` int(11) NOT NULL, `file` varchar(1200) NOT NULL, `date` varchar(23) NOT NULL, `mclass` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `hcomp` varchar(230) DEFAULT NULL, `hwch` varchar(250) DEFAULT NULL, `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `sid` (`sid`), KEY `tid` (`tid`), CONSTRAINT `home_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tid`) REFERENCES `step` (`id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2683 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `link` ( `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `code` varchar(40) NOT NULL, `email` varchar(40) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `email` (`email`), CONSTRAINT `link_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`email`) REFERENCES `step` (`email`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=76 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `lobh` ( `id` int(11) NOT NULL, `ip` varchar(40) NOT NULL, `os` varchar(40) NOT NULL, `brow` varchar(40) NOT NULL, `device` varchar(40) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `id` (`id`), CONSTRAINT `lobh_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`id`) REFERENCES `step` (`id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `marks` ( `mtid` int(11) NOT NULL, `mid` int(11) NOT NULL, `mname` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `mmarks` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `mdate` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `uid` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`mid`,`uid`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE `password` ( `pu` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `pmail` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `ppass` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `pfname` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL, `plname` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL, `pdate` date DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`pu`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=31 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE `step` ( `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(20) NOT NULL, `email` varchar(40) NOT NULL, `pass` varchar(40) NOT NULL, `identity` varchar(1) NOT NULL, `mclass` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `lverify` varchar(40) DEFAULT NULL, `cverify` int(1) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1721 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `student` ( `cid` int(11) NOT NULL, `cdate` date NOT NULL, `cshour` int(2) NOT NULL, `csmin` int(2) NOT NULL, `cehour` int(2) NOT NULL, `cemin` int(2) NOT NULL, `cfile` tinytext, `ctest` mediumtext, `cpass` varchar(40) NOT NULL, `uid` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, PRIMARY KEY (`cid`,`cpass`), UNIQUE KEY `uid` (`uid`), CONSTRAINT `student_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`cid`) REFERENCES `step` (`id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=24 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `teacher` ( `sid` int(11) NOT NULL, `tid` int(11) NOT NULL, `sfile` varchar(250) NOT NULL, `stext` varchar(40) NOT NULL, `spass` varchar(40) NOT NULL, `chdate` date NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`sfile`,`stext`,`chdate`), KEY `sid` (`sid`), CONSTRAINT `teacher_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`sid`) REFERENCES `step` (`id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `video` ( `sid` int(6) NOT NULL, `tid` int(6) NOT NULL, `sdata` mediumtext NOT NULL, `tdata` mediumtext, `cdate` varchar(40) NOT NULL, `vid` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `ver` int(1) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`vid`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
